jobs.title: Enterprise Partner Manager
jobs.description:
Yotpo is leading the next era of trust and loyalty in eCommerce. With AI-powered Reviews and Loyalty solutions, we help brands turn browsers into customers and customers into advocates. Through deep integrations across the eCommerce ecosystem and the trust of over 30,000 global brands, Yotpo delivers seamless omnichannel experiences that increase conversion, strengthen customer relationships, and drive profitable, long-term growth.

Yotpo has built a robust ecosystem of strategic partnerships with leading commerce platforms, global systems integrators, and full-service digital marketing and retail agencies that recommend, implement, and optimize Yotpo’s products on their clients’ ecommerce sites. Partners are one of Yotpo’s fastest-growing revenue channels, and this role sits at the center of that growth. We’re hiring an Enterprise Partner Manager to own relationships with our top agency and systems integrator (SI) partners. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, Global Partnerships. You’ll be accountable for the pipeline and revenue these partners drive, turning strong relationships into referrals, co-sell deals, and new enterprise brands on Yotpo.

Location: New York City ( hybrid , 3 days per week in office) or Remote

Compensation: $150,000–$180,000 OTE (70/30 base/variable split)

How you’ll make an impact:

- Own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of top agency and SI partners, driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue against defined targets

- Build relationships across every level of each partner, from strategists and delivery teams to agency and practice leadership, and serve as their primary point of contact at Yotpo

- Build and run joint business plans with each partner, including target account mapping, referral goals, and a regular operating cadence (QBRs, pipeline reviews, planning sessions)

- Partner with Account Executives and Solutions teams on complex enterprise sales cycles, bringing partners in at the right moments with clear roles and clean handoffs

- Train and enable partners on Yotpo’s products, positioning, and processes so they can confidently recommend and implement Yotpo for their clients

- Expand Yotpo’s reach across the agency and SI network in the broader Enterprise commerce platform ecosystem

- Track pipeline health, forecast partner-attached revenue, and surface blockers early so cross-functional teams can help remove them

- Bring partner and market feedback (what’s landing, what’s missing, where clients push back) into Product and go-to-market planning

- Help build the playbooks, processes, and best practices that scale Yotpo’s enterprise partner motion

How success is measured:

- Number of partners activated or producing referrals

- Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline

- Co-sell deals closed and net-new revenue

Who you’ll work with:

- Sales and Solutions teams to align on target accounts, co-sell motion, and deal strategy

- Customer Success and Delivery to ensure partner-led implementations deliver results for our shared brands

- Product to share partner and market feedback and align on integrations

- Marketing on co-marketing campaigns, joint events, and partner enablement content

What you’ll need:

- 5+ years of partner, channel, agency, or business development experience in a client-facing role, with a proven track record of hitting revenue targets

- Direct experience working with ecommerce agencies and/or systems integrators, ideally at a MarTech SaaS company, commerce platform, or agency

- A track record of driving revenue through partners: pipeline you built, deals you influenced, and relationships that outlasted any single transaction

- Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior and C-suite stakeholders

- AI fluency: you use AI tools every day to research, plan, and move faster, and you can speak credibly about how AI is changing eCommerce

- Strong commercial instincts and comfort navigating multi-party deal dynamics, including knowing when to push and when to let the partner lead

- Excellent presentation, communication, and listening skills

- A collaborative style that thrives in a fast-moving, matrixed, and sometimes ambiguous environment

Nice to have:

- Experience in the Shopify Plus, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, or rAdobe Commerce partner ecosystems

- Prior experience working at an eCommerce agency or systems integrator

- Experience as an early member of a partner function, helping it scale

If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, that’s okay! We believe in hiring people, not just skills. If you have a passion to learn and are excited about eCommerce and technology, then we want to hear from you.

About Yotpo US:

- 100% coverage of employee medical premiums; 90% coverage for dependent/family premiums.

- 100% coverage of employee dental + vision premiums.

- Comprehensive life and disability insurance.

- Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy, sick time, and paid holidays.

- Equity in options.

- Company sponsored 401K matching.

- Pre-tax Commuter and Healthcare benefits.

- Comprehensive paid leave for new parents and Dependent Care FSA.

- Individualized career development, rewards and recognition.

- Wellness and philanthropic programming and events.

- NYC-based team members work in a hybrid capacity, going into the office 3 days per week.

#LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: Enterprise Partner Manager - French Market, EMEA
jobs.description:
Yotpo is leading the next era of trust and loyalty in eCommerce. With AI-powered Reviews and Loyalty solutions, we help brands turn browsers into customers and customers into advocates. Through deep integrations across the eCommerce ecosystem and the trust of over 30,000 global brands, Yotpo delivers seamless omnichannel experiences that increase conversion, strengthen customer relationships, and drive profitable, long-term growth.

As an  Enterprise Partner Manager on our Partnerships team in EMEA, you’ll play a critical role in expanding Yotpo’s reach across the region through our most strategic agency and systems integrator (SI) partners.

You’ll own key commercial relationships, build joint growth strategies, and work cross-functionally to drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue across EMEA. This is a high-impact role for someone who knows how to turn strong relationships into meaningful business outcomes and thrives at the intersection of partnerships, sales, and the evolving eCommerce ecosystem.

Why Join Us

- Own high-impact EMEA partnerships: Manage a portfolio of strategic agency and SI partners across the region and directly influence pipeline, revenue, and growth.

- Shape our regional partner strategy: Help define how Yotpo scales through the EMEA agency and SI ecosystem, identifying opportunities to deepen existing partnerships and build new ones.

- Work at the center of growth: Collaborate closely with Account Executives, Solutions teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders on strategic sales opportunities across EMEA.

- Build a powerful regional network: Develop trusted relationships with agency leaders, commerce experts, and decision-makers across the EMEA ecosystem.

- Grow with the function: Help build and scale partner programs, processes, and operating models while expanding your own scope and leadership as the business grows.

- Stay ahead of eCommerce and AI: Work with partners and customers navigating the rapidly evolving commerce landscape and the impact of AI on how brands engage, market, and sell.

Key Responsibilities

- Own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of top agency and SI partners across EMEA, driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue against defined targets.

- Build relationships across every level of each partner—from strategists and delivery teams to agency and practice leadership—and serve as their primary point of contact at Yotpo.

- Build and execute joint business plans with each partner, including target account mapping, referral goals, and a consistent operating cadence through QBRs, pipeline reviews, and planning sessions.

- Partner with Account Executives and Solutions teams on complex sales opportunities, bringing partners into opportunities at the right moments with clear roles and seamless handoffs.

- Train and enable partners on Yotpo’s products, positioning, and processes so they can confidently recommend and implement Yotpo for their clients.

- Expand Yotpo’s reach across agency and SI networks within the broader EMEA commerce ecosystem.

- Identify opportunities to deepen strategic partnerships, increase partner engagement, and create new sources of growth across the region.

- Share regional market insights and partner feedback with internal teams to help inform Yotpo’s go-to-market strategy and continued growth in EMEA.

Required Skills

- 5+ years of partner, channel, agency, or business development experience in a client-facing role, with a proven track record of hitting revenue targets.

- Direct experience working with eCommerce agencies and/or systems integrators, ideally at a MarTech SaaS company, commerce platform, or agency.

- A track record of driving revenue through partners—including pipeline you built, deals you influenced, and relationships that outlasted any single transaction.

- Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

- Strong commercial instincts and comfort navigating multi-party deal dynamics, including knowing when to lead, when to influence, and when to let the partner lead.

- AI fluency: you use AI tools regularly to research, plan, and move faster, and can speak credibly about how AI is changing eCommerce.

- Excellent presentation, communication, listening, and negotiation skills.

- A collaborative approach and the ability to thrive in a fast-moving, matrixed, and sometimes ambiguous environment.

- A proactive, adaptable mindset with a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to roll up your sleeves to get things done.

Nice to Have

- Fluency in French is a major plus , particularly given the opportunity to build relationships with partners and customers across French-speaking markets.

- Experience working with enterprise customers or navigating complex enterprise sales cycles.

- Experience in the Shopify Plus, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, or Adobe Commerce partner ecosystems.

- Prior experience working at an eCommerce agency or systems integrator.

- Experience as an early member of a partner function, helping build and scale the team, programs, or operating model.

- An established network of agency, SI, or eCommerce ecosystem relationships across EMEA.

- Experience working across multiple EMEA markets and familiarity with the region’s diverse commerce ecosystem.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to build strategic partnerships, influence growth, and help shape how brands across EMEA navigate the rapidly evolving world of eCommerce, we’d love to hear from you.

At Yotpo, we value collaboration, ownership, curiosity, and continuous growth—and we’re building a team where different perspectives and experiences make us stronger. Join us and help shape what’s next.

About Yotpo - UK:

- Private healthcare with dental and optical included

- Pension contribution

- Voluntary death in service policy

- Cycle to work scheme

- Generous PTO, volunteer days, holidays and flex days

- Individualized career development, rewards and recognition

- Wellness and philanthropic programming and events

- We are working in a hybrid capacity, Central London office attendance on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday each week.

- Lunches provided..

At Yotpo, our culture is built around our people. We listen to employee feedback and turn it into meaningful opportunities to connect, learn, and celebrate — from team events and Lunch & Learns to end-of-year celebrations, affinity groups, and community partnerships. We’re always looking for new ways to make Yotpo a place where people feel connected, supported, and empowered to do their best work.

Yotpo is for everyone, and we’re committed to anti-racist work. We welcome and employ people regardless of race, color,  gender identity, religion, genetic information, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer,  a place where your voice is heard and your perspective is encouraged. Come join us and help us build a global company where we're all proud to belong.

jobs.title: Upmarket Customer Success Manager, Discover
jobs.description:
Yotpo is leading the next era of trust and loyalty in eCommerce. With AI-powered Reviews and Loyalty solutions, we help brands turn browsers into customers and customers into advocates. Through deep integrations across the eCommerce ecosystem and the trust of over 30,000 global brands, Yotpo delivers seamless omnichannel experiences that increase conversion, strengthen customer relationships, and drive profitable, long-term growth.

We’re looking for our first Customer Success Manager dedicated to Yotpo Discover—a strategic, hands-on operator who’s excited to help define what great looks like. This is a unique opportunity to join a new product at an early stage and build the Customer Success motion from the ground up. You’ll partner closely with Product and Sales while acting as a trusted advisor to eCommerce brands, helping them understand and improve how they appear across modern, AI-driven discovery experiences. The ideal candidate is someone with 3–5+ years of experience across Customer Success, SEO, or Growth, with hands-on SEO expertise and a track record of driving customer outcomes. You thrive in ambiguity and can translate technical concepts into clear, actionable business value

You’ll own customer relationships end-to-end—from post-onboarding through renewal—while shaping playbooks, success frameworks, and feedback loops that will scale alongside Discover.

About Yotpo Discover

Yotpo Discover helps e-commerce brands understand and improve how they appear across AI-driven discovery experiences, including search, AI answers, and shopping assistants. As discovery expands beyond traditional search, Discover gives SEO/AEO and e-commerce teams clear visibility into performance, gaps, and opportunities.

What You Will Do

- Own post-onboarding customer relationships through renewal, driving retention and expansion in close partnership with Account Managers and Customer Success teams across product lines.

- Help design and scale the Discover Customer Success motion, including optimization frameworks, success plans, QBR templates, expansion signals, and early customer playbooks

- Lead SEO + AEO audits using Yotpo Discover, translating AI discovery insights into concrete recommendations and measurable outcomes for customers

- Partner deeply with Product to shape roadmap direction through structured customer feedback, use cases, and validation sessions

- Lead strategic QBRs and executive-level conversations that align customer goals with Yotpo’s roadmap

- Build strong, multi-threaded relationships across customer organizations—from day-to-day operators to C-suite stakeholders

- Proactively track adoption and performance, identifying risk early and leading resolution strategies when challenges arise

About You:

- 3–5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, SEO, Growth, or Digital Strategy

- Hands-on SEO background is a plus (agency or in-house strongly preferred)

- Comfortable explaining AI search, LLM-driven answers, and modern discovery concepts to non-technical stakeholders

- Builder mentality—thrives in early-stage environments and excited to create structure where none exists

- Strategic advisor with experience managing complex customer relationships and engaging executive audiences

- Analytical and data-driven, using insights to measure performance and demonstrate business impact.

- Exceptional communicator and storyteller with strong presentation skills

If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, that’s okay! We believe in hiring people, not just skills. If you have a passion to learn and are excited about eCommerce and technology, then we want to hear from you.

About Yotpo CA:

- Company sponsored RRSP matching.

- 100% coverage of additional benefits programme.

- Equity in options.

- Individualized career development, rewards and recognition.

- Wellness and philanthropic programming and events.

- We are working in a hybrid model, typically in the office 3-4 days per week.

At Yotpo, our culture is built around our people. We listen to employee feedback and turn it into meaningful opportunities to connect, learn, and celebrate — from team events and Lunch & Learns to end-of-year celebrations, affinity groups, and community partnerships. We’re always looking for new ways to make Yotpo a place where people feel connected, supported, and empowered to do their best work.

Yotpo is for everyone, and we’re committed to anti-racist work. We welcome and employ people regardless of race, color,  gender identity, religion, genetic information, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer,  a place where your voice is heard and your perspective is encouraged. Come join us and help us build a global company where we're all proud to belong.

Base salary $105,000-130,000 CAD

In addition to base salary, this role includes a variable compensation component.

Base salary ranges are determined by multiple factors unique to each candidate, including skills and local market benchmarks.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) Disclosure
If AI is used to screen, assess, or select applicants, employers must disclose this in the publicly advertised job posting. “AI” is broadly defined to mean “a machine-based system that, for explicit or implicit objectives, infers from the input it receives in order to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations or decisions that can influence physical or virtual environments.
